action_items: OPTIONAL a11y: add <DialogDescription> to buy/checkout dialogs in ClientGallery to silence Radix warnings.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py run_paid_automation (line 968) is idempotent via atomic '$ne: True' guard on automation_done — verified: replaying webhook does NOT create duplicate receita/notifications/activity/emails.

server.py stripe_webhook (line 1099) sets payment_status='paid' with idempotency guard {payment_status: {$ne: paid}} then calls run_paid_automation — operational status is untouched (Option B), as required.
server.py update_order_status (line 1499) correctly emits order_cancelled / order_completed notifications on manual state changes — validated.
server.py dashboard_stats (line 1550) computes total_sales/paid_orders/avg_ticket from paid store_orders and store_revenue_month using paid_at prefix (YYYY-MM). Good.
server.py send_email_raw (line 902) is defensive: returns False silently on missing EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY or empty 'to'. History logs 'Falha ao enviar...' correctly.
server.py — file is now 2426 lines, still exceeds 700-line guideline. Suggest splitting notifications/activities/dashboard/store/payments/receivables modules.

server.py public_store_order (line 1006): still uses body.get('origin_url') unchecked to build Stripe success/cancel redirect URLs. Malicious client could redirect users away — consider validating origin against an allowlist derived from FRONTEND_BASE_URL.
NotificationBell.jsx polls /notifications/unread-count every 20s — reasonable but consider Server-Sent Events / websocket for real-time badge updates.
Dashboard.jsx fetches /dashboard/stats and /activities?limit=8 on mount only — no live refresh. Adding a subtle polling or refresh after cross-tab actions would improve UX (nice-to-have).
